_: Built by scripts/build_vintage_shops.py from data/things.json (Shopping group: vintage, thrift, consignment, antique and record shops). Walking order. Nothing here is typed by hand; a fact things.json lacks is listed in the shop's gaps. Add or fix a shop in things.json and rebuild.

shops.name: Burlington Records
shops.hours: Mon–Wed 10am to 7pm · Thu–Fri 10am to 8pm · Sat 10am to 8:30pm · Sun 10am to 7pm
shops.blurb: Downtown Burlington's independent vinyl shop with an extensive catalog organized by genre and era.

checked.note: Address, phone and hours from the Location & Hours block on the shop's site. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's Burlington Records node at 194 College St. The shop has moved from the Church and Bank corner; older listings still give that address.

shops.name: Outdoor Gear Exchange
shops.hours: Mon–Fri 11am to 7pm · Sat 10am to 7pm · Sun 10am to 6pm
shops.blurb: Church Street's legendary gear shop — new equipment up top, and a consignment section where patient people score serious deals on used outdoor kit.

checked.note: Hours and address from the shop's Hours & Location page; coordinates from the Google Maps link on that page.

shops.name: Battery St. Jeans
shops.hours: Mon 11am to 6pm · Wed–Sat 11am to 6pm · Sun 11am to 5pm · closed Tue
shops.blurb: Used and vintage clothing at fair prices on College Street, from a shop that opened on Battery Street in 1991.

checked.note: Hours from the shop's home page; address and phone from its contact page. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's Battery Street Jeans node at 115 College St.

shops.name: Dirt Chic
shops.hours_note: Consignment drop-off Wed–Sat 11am to 5pm, Sun 1pm to 4pm
shops.blurb: Upscale consignment on lower Main Street, between Pine and South Champlain: women's, men's, kids', bridal and maternity clothes and accessories.

checked.note: Hours, address and phone from the shop's Hours & Location page. A June 2026 Hello Burlington guide says Sunday to 6pm; the shop's own page says 5pm and is used. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's Dirt Chic node at 67 Main St.

shops.name: ReSOURCE
shops.hours: Tue 10am to 5pm · Thu–Sat 10am to 5pm · closed Mon, Wed, Sun
shops.blurb: The nonprofit ReSOURCE's thrift store on Pine Street, stocked with donated secondhand goods.

checked.note: Address, phone and hours from the ReSOURCE Burlington block of the nonprofit's Store Location & Hours page; its Williston and Morrisville stores keep other hours. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's ReSOURCE node at 339 Pine St.

shops.name: Speaking Volumes
shops.hours: Mon–Fri 10am to 5pm · Sat 9am to 5pm · Sun 10am to 3pm
shops.hours_note: Tue and Wed may close early; one page of its site says Fri until 9pm
shops.blurb: Tens of thousands of used and rare books on Pine Street, with vintage ephemera, magazines and art mixed in.

checked.note: Hours from 'Bookstore Hours' on the home page. The site's /bookstore page says Friday 10 to 9 and drops the '(or earlier)' on Tue and Wed; the home page, which also carries the newer Randolph store, is used. Coordinates from the Google Maps link on the shop's site. The Marble Ave record store was sold in 2026 and is a separate shop now.

shops.name: Barge Canal Market
shops.hours_note: It posts the day's hours on Facebook
shops.blurb: Vintage furniture and home decor in the Pine Street building it shares with Speaking Volumes: mid-century design, old industrial pieces and farmhouse finds.

checked.note: No weekly hours published anywhere reachable; the shop posts the day's hours on Facebook. Its old domain bargecanalmarket.com now redirects to an unrelated gambling site, so it is not linked. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's building at 377 Pine St.

shops.name: Junktiques Collective
shops.hours: Wed–Sat 11am to 7pm · Sun noon to 5pm · closed Mon, Tue
shops.blurb: North Winooski Avenue's dig-for-it thrift trove — furniture, oddities, and the occasional genuine score priced like nobody checked.

checked.note: Address, phone and hours from the shop's site footer ('Wed - Sat 11a - 7p, Sun 12p - 5p'); Mon and Tue are not listed and are taken as closed. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's building at 324 N Winooski Ave.

shops.name: Autumn Records
shops.address: 11 E. Allen St., Suite 2, Winooski, VT 05404
shops.blurb: A Winooski record store run by an internationally recognized experimental musician — the curation reflects that.

checked.note: Address, phone and hours ('12-6pm / 7 days a week') from the Winooski block of the shop's site; its Waterbury store keeps different hours. Coordinates from the map on the shop's site; OpenStreetMap agrees.

shops.name: Vintage Inspired Marketplace
shops.blurb: More than 60 antique and vintage dealers under one roof at Dorset Street and Williston Road, with old paper ephemera and craft supplies alongside the furniture and decor.

checked.note: Address, phone and hours ('Mon-Sat 10-6 Sun 12-6') from the shop's contact page and home page; coordinates from the Google Maps link on its home page. A June 2026 Hello Burlington guide says closed Tuesdays and Suite 8B; the shop's own 'open daily' and '#2' are used. It moved from Flynn Ave to Dorset St in 2023.

shops.name: Goodwill South Burlington
shops.blurb: The big thrift store on Shelburne Road: donated clothing and household goods, open every day.

checked.note: Address, phone and hours from the South Burlington entry on Goodwill of Northern New England's locations page. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's Goodwill at 1080 Shelburne Rd.

shops.name: Five Corners Antiques
shops.blurb: A massive multi-dealer antique depot in Essex, fifteen minutes out — the kind of place you enter curious and exit two hours later carrying a lamp.

checked.note: The shop's website (5cornersantiques.com) is a parked domain. Its last reachable listing is its own April 2024 ad in the Journal of Antiques: 11 Maple Street (Route 117), Mon-Sat 10-5, Sun 11-4. OpenStreetMap puts it at 156 Railroad St, Unit 3 and lists Mon-Sat 10-3. With no current page of its own and two addresses, address and hours are left empty until someone calls. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap's Five Corners Antiques node. A 2026 Seven Daysies finalist, so open.
